About HaltH
HaltH is a platform for online bookings, payments, and health fund claims, purpose-built for health.
We connect members, providers, and health funders, making the entire experience, from appointment to reimbursement, easier, faster, and more transparent.
All transactions on HaltH are powered by secure, best-in-class payment infrastructure that protects health and financial data to the highest global standards.
We're based in Surry Hills, Sydney, and love building products that challenge the usual way things are done.
Intro
We're an early stage tech company building our foundation team so seeking an Intermediate Full-Stack Software Developer to join our dynamic team.
We have several projects under development, including the platform API, integrations, websites, mobile apps, and browser extensions so we're looking for people that can contribute to any or all of these projects.
We're moving quickly, but are focused on keeping a tight team of A+ players, so there will be plenty of opportunities to specialise and grow within the company.
Skills and Experience
Must Haves
Minimum of 3 years experience in full-stack development (a degree is not required).
Solid experience with TypeScript, developing real-world applications.
Experience with one or more of: NodeJS, NestJS, NextJS, ReactJS, React Native, Expo, Plasmo.
Experience with testing, writing unit/integration tests: Playwright, Jest.
Solid understanding of RESTful API design, implementation, and integration.
Must have the right to work in Australia
Nice to Haves
Experience with AWS or similar cloud hosting services, specifically: Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, EventBridge, RDS/Aurora, ECS Fargate.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools: AWS CDK or Terraform.
Experience developing mobile apps and/or browser extensions.
Experience working with event-driven architectures and messaging systems: AWS SQS, EventBridge.
Experience with CI/CD, release workflows, monitoring, and observability: GitHub, CloudWatch, Grafana.
Experience with databases, data-modelling, writing migration scripts, optimising queries: Postgres, SQL, TypeORM.
Responsibilities
Use your skills and experience to develop the ecosystem of HaltH products.
Participate in the full software development life cycle, including design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
Write unit tests and integration tests to ensure software quality.
Follow best practices for software development and contribute to continuous improvement within the team.
Collaborate with the team to translate business requirements into functional software features.
Why join HaltH
We're a startup that's well-capitalised but grounded, meaning every dollar goes into building an amazing experience for everyone who touches the platform.
If you're after a cushy gig with endless perks and beanbags, this probably isn't for you. We're here to build, to learn, and to make an impact.
But here's what you
will
get:
The chance to work alongside people who've done it before, who are here for the long game, and who are just as invested in your growth as they are in our mission.
A team of driven, passionate people, who care deeply about health, community, and building something meaningful, 51%'ers with a high talent bar and the work ethic to match.
The opportunity to learn and grow every day while solving some of the most interesting problems in a collaborative, open environment.
The ability to own your work, your ideas will be valued no matter your role, and you'll have the freedom (and responsibility) to make a real impact.
Equity that makes you a true owner, letting you share in the upside as HaltH grows.
A culture of building in the open, we share freely, iterate quickly, and move at pace to deliver value fast.
Don’t provide your bank or credit card details when applying for jobs.
